motion.name: sheet-spring

motion.name: baku-chew
motion.purpose: Wait for palette readiness and finish at a full chew boundary.

motion.name: baku-release
motion.purpose: Sneeze release before the landing beat.

motion.name: baku-landing
motion.purpose: Swatches land in their usable controls.

motion.name: chip-flight
motion.purpose: A short jet follows the moving nostril axis before fanning to chip targets; approved study bb16e1e.

motion.name: performance-lifecycle
motion.value: one result route and mounted photo/Baku from selection through upload, extraction and reveal; UI-thread clock pauses while backgrounded, unfocused, photo undisplayed, art unloaded, or failed; skip to corner when ready; Reduced Motion omits dust/flight
motion.purpose: Code behavior, not native performance or gesture acceptance.

motion.name: baku-upload-intake
motion.purpose: Subtle snout opening and neutral paper dust link the retained photograph to Baku while uploading.

motion.name: baku-balloon-flight
motion.value: start 0.31s after sneeze onset; duration 1.75s; target width 72pt
motion.purpose: One colored knit mesh shrinks and winds into the lower-left corner after all swatches launch; capture-seeded variation stays deterministic.

breakpoints.name: accessible-chip-column
breakpoints.value: fontScale > 1.25 (native text-scale threshold, not a CSS viewport breakpoint)

mobileInteractionContracts.savedKit: Use this kit is primary; editing is immediate. Reopening does not replay extraction.
mobileInteractionContracts.editing: Expanded entry, live draft, anchored Save/Cancel, blur-or-submit validation, explicit dirty discard.
mobileInteractionContracts.collections: Actual photo and six-role stock cards; retain data through focus refresh failures. Index uses name/count without invented previews.
mobileInteractionContracts.feedback: Restrained paper press and one light haptic; nonspatial Reduced Motion feedback.
mobileInteractionContracts.verification: Source and bounded Expo Web fixtures only; Keep375 paint inconclusive, native device acceptance pending.

components.name: Enamel action
components.description: Native ActionButton translated to CSS. Keyboard outline is a panel-only affordance; no native hover style is claimed.
components.css: .ds-enamel-action { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #7E93B5; border-radius: 24px; background: #426092; color: #FBF8F2; font: 500 16px "Geist", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #2D4163, 4px 8px 12px #1C1B1928, inset 0 1px 1px #FFFFFF77, inset 0 -1px 1px #00000019; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-enamel-action:hover { background-color: #426092; } .ds-enamel-action:active { transform: translateY(2px); background-color: #3D5988; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #2D4163, 1px 2px 4px #1C1B1928, inset 0 1px 2px #1C1B1933, inset 0 -1px 1px #00000019; } .ds-enamel-action:disabled { box-shadow: none; opacity: .5; cursor: default; } .ds-enamel-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C1B19; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-enamel-action { transition: none; } .ds-enamel-action:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Paper action
components.description: Native ActionButton translated to CSS. Keyboard outline is a panel-only affordance; no native hover style is claimed.
components.css: .ds-paper-action { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #FFFDF8; border-radius: 5px; background: #F7F1E6; color: #1C1B19; font: 500 16px "Geist", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #C5BBAB, 3px 7px 11px #1C1B1928, inset 0 1px 1px #FFFFFF77, inset 0 -1px 1px #00000019; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-paper-action:hover { background-color: #F7F1E6; } .ds-paper-action:active { transform: translateY(2px); background-color: #EDE7DD; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #C5BBAB, 1px 2px 4px #1C1B1928, inset 0 1px 2px #1C1B1933, inset 0 -1px 1px #00000019; } .ds-paper-action:disabled { box-shadow: none; opacity: .5; cursor: default; } .ds-paper-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C1B19; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-paper-action { transition: none; } .ds-paper-action:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Hex field

components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Hex color<input class="ds-field" value="#426092" aria-label="Hex color" spellcheck="false"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #1C1B19; font: 500 14px/20px "Geist", sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #1C1B19; border-radius: 12px; background: #F3EEE4; color: #1C1B19; font: 400 17px "Geist", sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #1C1B19; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C1B19; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Paper back control
components.description: A 36-unit paper face inside a 44-unit native target, translated to a browser preview.
components.css: .ds-back { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #1C1B19; cursor: pointer; } .ds-back-face { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid #FFFDF8; border-radius: 18px; background: #F7F1E6; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #C5BBAB, 3px 7px 11px #1C1B1928, inset 0 1px 1px #FFFFFF77, inset 0 -1px 1px #00000019; } .ds-back:hover .ds-back-face { background: #F7F1E6; } .ds-back:active .ds-back-face { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C1B19; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-back:active .ds-back-face { transform: none; } }

components.name: Paint chip
components.description: PaintChip face and stock label; enamel blue is an example swatch, not a fabricated photo sample. The native source uses Skia paper texture.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: block; width: 132px; min-height: 196px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: .5px solid #1C1B1940; border-top-color: #FFFFFF99; border-left-color: #FFFFFF88; border-radius: 3px; background: #FBF8F2; color: #1C1B19; text-align: left; box-shadow: 1px 2px 1px #1C1B193B, 5px 9px 16px #1C1B191A; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-paint { display: block; height: 117px; background: #426092; } .ds-chip-tints { display: flex; height: 16px; } .ds-chip-tints i { flex: 1; background: #97A8C3; } .ds-chip-tints i:nth-child(2) { background: #6C83AA; } .ds-chip-tints i:nth-child(3) { background: #334B72; } .ds-chip-label { display: grid; gap: 0; padding: 3px 4px 6px; } .ds-chip-label strong { font: 600 14.6667px/1.2 "Geist", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.7px; } .ds-chip-hex { font: 400 14.6667px/1.2 "Geist Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: -.7px; } .ds-chip:hover { box-shadow: 1px 2px 1px #1C1B193B, 5px 9px 16px #1C1B191A; } .ds-chip:active { box-shadow: 1px 2px 1px #1C1B193B, 3px 15px 25px #1C1B1945; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C1B19; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-empty-chip { display: grid; width: 132px; min-height: 196px; padding: 0; border: .5px solid #1C1B1940; border-top-color: #FFFFFF99; border-left-color: #FFFFFF88; border-radius: 3px; background: #E4D9C6; color: #1C1B19; text-align: left; box-shadow: 1px 2px 1px #1C1B193B, 5px 9px 16px #1C1B191A; cursor: pointer; } .ds-empty-body { display: grid; align-items: center; padding: 6px 9px; } .ds-empty-body em { padding: 9px 0; border-top: 1px dashed #857B68; border-bottom: 1px dashed #857B68; font: italic 400 14.6667px/1.15 "Geist", sans-serif; } .ds-empty-role { padding: 3px 4px 6px; font: 600 14.6667px/1.2 "Geist", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.7px; } .ds-empty-chip:hover { background: #E4D9C6; } .ds-empty-chip:active { box-shadow: 1px 2px 1px #1C1B193B, 3px 15px 25px #1C1B1945; } .ds-empty-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C1B19; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.northStar: A photographed moment becomes a usable creative kit
narrative.overview:
Inzpo's mobile world is a small collection of creative materials: cream paper, a photographic print, dimensional paint-chip stock, blue enamel controls, and a gray knitted Baku. Akaya Kanadaka gives the interface its friendly voice; Geist makes the working information clear. Photos and their extracted colors supply the changing character of each kit.

The tactile treatment carries meaning. A print holds source evidence, a chip holds a named color, and a fan deck makes a saved kit feel like something to keep and reuse. Baku's connected wool body and actual stitched panels carry the photo-to-palette performance. Material detail belongs to those objects and should leave their labels readable.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and dark ink form the stable interface.
Photos and sampled colors lead the content.
Stock, enamel, and knit have distinct surfaces and depth.
Expressive headings sit above plain working text and precise hex values.
Motion connects a source photo to usable color controls.

rules.name: The Source Color Rule
rules.body: A kit's swatch, source-pin center, and Baku panel use the kit's actual color value. Decorative tint strips are material variations, not additional extracted colors or source evidence.

rules.name: The Honest Empty Rule
rules.body: A missing role stays empty: oatmeal chip stock and a gray Baku panel communicate the absence without inventing a swatch or sample pin.

rules.name: The Readable Stock Rule
rules.body: Keep paint-chip role names and hex values on light stock below the painted face. Let labels grow and painted areas compress when text needs room.

rules.name: The Material Depth Rule
rules.body: Match depth to the object: thin stock, compressed enamel, and soft knit have different surfaces. The lip of an enamel control and the contact shadow of paper are material cues, not a generic shadow for every container.

dos: **Do** preserve cream paper, photographic prints, paint-chip stock, blue enamel actions, and Baku's knit as distinct materials.
**Do** use actual kit colors for swatches, sample markers, and Baku panels; keep empty roles visibly empty.
**Do** keep readable chip labels on stock and accommodate font scaling with layout growth.
**Do** reuse the same paint-chip component in the interactive pile, saved deck, and keep fan.
**Do** preserve the explicit skip, Reduced Motion result path, and background pause.
**Do** treat phone layout, text scaling, performance, and gestures as pending until verified on the target device.
donts: **Don't** promote decorative tint strips into extracted colors or source evidence.
**Don't** turn one screen's overlap, tilt, or artwork measurements into a universal layout rule.
**Don't** substitute the shared Fraunces export for the mobile Akaya display font.
**Don't** use sidecar previews or Skia character stills as proof of native phone acceptance.
